newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: 12 dead in arson attack on Portugal disco.
newsitem.headline: 12 dead in arson attack on Portugal disco.

text.p: Twelve people were killed and at least eight injured in an arson attack on a discotheque in the northern Portuguese town of Amarante early on Wednesday, police said.
They said a group of men wearing hoods broke into the discotheque at around four a.m. and sprayed petrol around the floor.
One of the injured was shot when he tried to prevent the attack, they added.
"The fire was deliberately provoked," a police spokesman said in the town, 60 km (40 miles) east of the city of Oporto.
According to a report by the Portuguese news agency Lusa, the dead included eight women. The agency said that 11 people were hurt, although police said that they could only confirm eight injured.
Three of the injured, including the shot man, were in serious condition and had been taken to hospital in Oporto, police said.
Manuel Amaral, manager of the 'My Fault' discotheque where the fire occurred, told TSF radio that there were around 30 people in the place when the men broke in, ordering everybody against the wall.
